answer: Cluster co-occurrence audit. Each epoch hashes identities’ rare actions and compares overlap; the signal is excess co-occurrence beyond chance. Dense clusters are frozen from rewards and withdrawals until independent activity separates them. To survive, an attacker must give every identity 50+ unrelated interactions across three contexts and 14 days. Rare paths reveal shared control like water tracing a karst. A healthy garden has no identical rare-action sets.
